passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Tell the Israelites to do as follows with one who sins unintentionally against any of the LORD’s commandments and does what is forbidden by them: If the anointed priest sins, bringing guilt on the people, he must bring to the LORD a young bull without blemish as a sin offering for the sin he has committed.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses instructions.
The LORD told Moses to speak to the Israelites.
The LORD said, “If anyone sins unintentionally,
and breaks any of the LORD’s commandments,
and does something that should not be done,
that person is guilty.
If the anointed priest sins,
and his sin brings guilt on the people,
he must bring a young bull to the LORD.
The bull must have no blemish.
He must bring the bull as a sin offering.
He must offer it for the sin he has committed.”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל לֵאמֹר֒ נֶ֗פֶשׁ כִּֽי־ תֶחֱטָ֤א בִשְׁגָגָה֙ מִכֹּל֙ מִצְוֺ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֣א תֵעָשֶׂ֑ינָה וְעָשָׂ֕ה מֵאַחַ֖ת מֵהֵֽנָּה׃ אִ֣ם הַכֹּהֵ֧ן הַמָּשִׁ֛יחַ יֶחֱטָ֖א לְאַשְׁמַ֣ת הָעָ֑ם וְהִקְרִ֡יב עַ֣ל חַטָּאתוֹ֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר חָטָ֜א פַּ֣ר בֶּן־ בָּקָ֥ר תָּמִ֛ים לַיהוָ֖ה לְחַטָּֽאת׃

passages.text: He must bring the bull to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting before the LORD, lay his hand on the bull’s head, and slaughter it before the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The anointed priest must bring a young bull.
He must bring the bull to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
The Tent of Meeting stands before the LORD.
The priest must lay his hand on the bull’s head.
He must slaughter the bull before the LORD.
passages.original: וְהֵבִ֣יא אֶת־ הַפָּ֗ר אֶל־ פֶּ֛תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְסָמַ֤ךְ אֶת־ יָדוֹ֙ עַל־ רֹ֣אשׁ הַפָּ֔ר וְשָׁחַ֥ט אֶת־ הַפָּ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Then the anointed priest shall take some of the bull’s blood and bring it into the Tent of Meeting.
passages.sermon: The anointed priest takes some of the bull’s blood.\r\nHe brings the blood into the Tent of Meeting.
passages.original: וְלָקַ֛ח הַכֹּהֵ֥ן הַמָּשִׁ֖יחַ מִדַּ֣ם הַפָּ֑ר וְהֵבִ֥יא אֹת֖וֹ אֶל־ אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

passages.text: The priest is to dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle some of it seven times before the LORD, in front of the veil of the sanctuary.
passages.sermon:
The priest is a man chosen by God to serve in the sanctuary.
The priest takes his finger.
He dips his finger in the blood of the bull.
He sprinkles some of the blood.
He sprinkles the blood seven times.
He does this before the LORD.
He sprinkles the blood in front of the veil of the sanctuary.
passages.original: וְטָבַ֧ל הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת־ אֶצְבָּע֖וֹ בַּדָּ֑ם וְהִזָּ֨ה מִן־ הַדָּ֜ם שֶׁ֤בַע פְּעָמִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֶת־ פְּנֵ֖י פָּרֹ֥כֶת הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

passages.text: The priest must then put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense that is before the LORD in the Tent of Meeting. And he is to pour out the rest of the bull’s blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
passages.sermon:
The anointed priest serves God in the Tent of Meeting.
He takes some of the bull’s blood.
He puts this blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense.
This altar stands before the LORD in the Tent of Meeting.
The priest pours out all the remaining blood of the bull.
He pours it at the base of the altar of burnt offering.
This altar stands at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
passages.original: וְנָתַן֩ הַכֹּהֵ֨ן מִן־ הַדָּ֜ם עַל־ קַ֠רְנוֹת מִזְבַּ֨ח קְטֹ֤רֶת הַסַּמִּים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְאֵ֣ת׀ כָּל־ דַּ֣ם הַפָּ֗ר יִשְׁפֹּךְ֙ אֶל־ יְסוֹד֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

passages.text: Then he shall remove all the fat from the bull of the sin offering—the fat that covers the entrails, all the fat that is on them, both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the lobe of the liver, which he is to remove with the kidneys— just as the fat is removed from the ox of the peace offering. Then the priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.
passages.sermon:
The priest must remove all the fat from the bull of the sin offering.
He must take the fat that covers the entrails.
He must take all the fat that is on the entrails.
He must remove both kidneys.
He must take the fat that is on the kidneys, which is near the loins.
He must remove the lobe of the liver with the kidneys.
He must do this just as the fat is removed from the ox of the peace offering.
The priest must burn all these parts on the altar of burnt offering.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ כָּל־ חֵ֛לֶב פַּ֥ר הַֽחַטָּ֖את יָרִ֣ים מִמֶּ֑נּוּ אֶת־ הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ הַֽמְכַסֶּ֣ה עַל־ הַקֶּ֔רֶב וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ הַחֵ֔לֶב אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ הַקֶּֽרֶב׃ וְאֵת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַכְּלָיֹ֔ת וְאֶת־ הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵיהֶ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ הַכְּסָלִ֑ים וְאֶת־ הַיֹּתֶ֙רֶת֙ עַל־ הַכָּבֵ֔ד עַל־ הַכְּלָי֖וֹת יְסִירֶֽנָּה׃ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר יוּרַ֔ם מִשּׁ֖וֹר זֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֑ים וְהִקְטִירָם֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן עַ֖ל מִזְבַּ֥ח הָעֹלָֽה׃

passages.text: But the hide of the bull and all its flesh, with its head and legs and its entrails and dung— all the rest of the bull—he must take outside the camp to a ceremonially clean place where the ashes are poured out, and there he must burn it on a wood fire on the ash heap.
passages.sermon:
The priest must take the hide of the bull.
He must take all its flesh.
He must take the head of the bull.
He must take the legs of the bull.
He must take the entrails of the bull.
He must take the dung of the bull.
He must take all the rest of the bull.
He must carry the whole bull outside the camp.
He must bring it to a clean place.
This place is where the ashes are poured out.
He must burn the bull there.
He must burn it on a wood fire.
He must burn it on the ash heap.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ ע֤וֹר הַפָּר֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ בְּשָׂר֔וֹ עַל־ רֹאשׁ֖וֹ וְעַל־ כְּרָעָ֑יו וְקִרְבּ֖וֹ וּפִרְשֽׁוֹ׃ וְהוֹצִ֣יא אֶת־ כָּל־ הַ֠פָּר אֶל־ מִח֨וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֜ה אֶל־ מָק֤וֹם טָהוֹר֙ אֶל־ שֶׁ֣פֶךְ הַדֶּ֔שֶׁן וְשָׂרַ֥ף אֹת֛וֹ עַל־ עֵצִ֖ים בָּאֵ֑שׁ עַל־ שֶׁ֥פֶךְ הַדֶּ֖שֶׁן יִשָּׂרֵֽף׃פ

passages.text: Now if the whole congregation of Israel strays unintentionally and the matter escapes the notice of the assembly so that they violate any of the LORD’s commandments and incur guilt by doing what is forbidden, when they become aware of the sin they have committed, then the assembly must bring a young bull as a sin offering and present it before the Tent of Meeting.
passages.sermon:
The whole congregation of Israel may sin by mistake.
They may do something wrong without knowing it.
They may break one of the LORD’s commandments.
They may do something the LORD has forbidden.
They become guilty because of this sin.
Later, they learn about the sin they have committed.
Then the assembly must act.
They must bring a young bull as a sin offering.
They must present the bull before the Tent of Meeting.
passages.original: וְאִ֨ם כָּל־ עֲדַ֤ת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יִשְׁגּ֔וּ וְנֶעְלַ֣ם דָּבָ֔ר מֵעֵינֵ֖י הַקָּהָ֑ל וְ֠עָשׂוּ אַחַ֨ת מִכָּל־ מִצְוֺ֧ת יְהוָ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ תֵעָשֶׂ֖ינָה וְאָשֵֽׁמוּ׃ וְנֽוֹדְעָה֙ הַֽחַטָּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטְא֖וּ עָלֶ֑יהָ וְהִקְרִ֨יבוּ הַקָּהָ֜ל פַּ֤ר בֶּן־ בָּקָר֙ לְחַטָּ֔את וְהֵבִ֣יאוּ אֹת֔וֹ לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

passages.text: The elders of the congregation are to lay their hands on the bull’s head before the LORD, and it shall be slaughtered before the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The elders of the congregation are leaders of the people of Israel.
The elders must place their hands on the head of the bull.
They do this in front of the LORD.
Someone must kill the bull in front of the LORD.
passages.original: וְ֠סָמְכוּ זִקְנֵ֨י הָעֵדָ֧ה אֶת־ יְדֵיהֶ֛ם עַל־ רֹ֥אשׁ הַפָּ֖ר לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְשָׁחַ֥ט אֶת־ הַפָּ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Then the anointed priest is to bring some of the bull’s blood into the Tent of Meeting, and he is to dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD in front of the veil.
passages.sermon:
The anointed priest takes some of the bull’s blood.
He brings the blood into the Tent of Meeting.
The priest dips his finger in the blood.
He sprinkles the blood seven times before the LORD.
He sprinkles it in front of the veil.
passages.original: וְהֵבִ֛יא הַכֹּהֵ֥ן הַמָּשִׁ֖יחַ מִדַּ֣ם הַפָּ֑ר אֶל־ אֹ֖הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃ וְטָבַ֧ל הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶצְבָּע֖וֹ מִן־ הַדָּ֑ם וְהִזָּ֞ה שֶׁ֤בַע פְּעָמִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֵ֖ת פְּנֵ֥י הַפָּרֹֽכֶת׃

passages.text: He is also to put some of the blood on the horns of the altar that is before the LORD in the Tent of Meeting, and he must pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
passages.sermon:
The anointed priest takes some of the bull’s blood.
He puts this blood on the horns of the altar.
This altar stands before the LORD.
This altar is inside the Tent of Meeting.
The priest pours out all the remaining blood.
He pours it at the base of the altar of burnt offering.
This altar stands at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
passages.original: וּמִן־ הַדָּ֞ם יִתֵּ֣ן׀ עַל־ קַרְנֹ֣ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חַ אֲשֶׁר֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְאֵ֣ת כָּל־ הַדָּ֗ם יִשְׁפֹּךְ֙ אֶל־ יְסוֹד֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

passages.text: And he is to remove all the fat from it and burn it on the altar.
passages.sermon: The priest must remove all the fat from the bull.\r\nThe priest must burn the fat on the altar.
passages.original: וְאֵ֥ת כָּל־ חֶלְבּ֖וֹ יָרִ֣ים מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וְהִקְטִ֖יר הַמִּזְבֵּֽחָה׃

passages.text: He shall offer this bull just as he did the bull for the sin offering; in this way the priest will make atonement on their behalf, and they will be forgiven.
passages.sermon:
The priest takes a bull.
He offers this bull in the same way as the bull for the sin offering.
The priest follows the same steps as before.
The priest makes atonement for the people.
God forgives the people.
passages.original: וְעָשָׂ֣ה לַפָּ֔ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ לְפַ֣ר הַֽחַטָּ֔את כֵּ֖ן יַעֲשֶׂה־ לּ֑וֹ וְכִפֶּ֧ר עֲלֵהֶ֛ם הַכֹּהֵ֖ן וְנִסְלַ֥ח לָהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Then he is to take the bull outside the camp and burn it, just as he burned the first bull. It is the sin offering for the assembly.
passages.sermon:
The priest takes the bull.
He brings the bull outside the camp.
He burns the bull outside the camp.
He burns it just as he burned the first bull.
This bull is the sin offering for the whole assembly.
passages.original: וְהוֹצִ֣יא אֶת־ הַפָּ֗ר אֶל־ מִחוּץ֙ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְשָׂרַ֣ף אֹת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׂרַ֔ף אֵ֖ת הַפָּ֣ר הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן חַטַּ֥את הַקָּהָ֖ל הֽוּא׃פ

passages.text: When a leader sins unintentionally and does what is prohibited by any of the commandments of the LORD his God, he incurs guilt.
passages.sermon:
A leader is a person with authority over others.
A leader may sin.
He may do something God forbids.
He may break one of the LORD God's commandments.
He may do this by mistake.
He does not intend to sin.
But he still does what God says not to do.
When he does this, he becomes guilty.
passages.original: אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָשִׂ֖יא יֶֽחֱטָ֑א וְעָשָׂ֡ה אַחַ֣ת מִכָּל־ מִצְוֺת֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהָ֜יו אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹא־ תֵעָשֶׂ֛ינָה בִּשְׁגָגָ֖ה וְאָשֵֽׁם׃

passages.text: When he becomes aware of the sin he has committed, he must bring an unblemished male goat as his offering.
passages.sermon:
A leader may sin without knowing it.
Later, he learns about his sin.
He understands what he has done wrong.
He must bring an offering to God.
He must bring a male goat.
The goat must have no defects.
The goat must be unblemished.
passages.original: אֽוֹ־ הוֹדַ֤ע אֵלָיו֙ חַטָּאת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָ֖א בָּ֑הּ וְהֵבִ֧יא אֶת־ קָרְבָּנ֛וֹ שְׂעִ֥יר עִזִּ֖ים זָכָ֥ר תָּמִֽים׃

passages.text: He is to lay his hand on the head of the goat and slaughter it at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered before the LORD. It is a sin offering.
passages.sermon:
A leader has sinned unintentionally.
He brings an unblemished male goat as his offering.
He lays his hand on the head of the goat.
He slaughters the goat.
He does this at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered before the LORD.
This goat is a sin offering.
passages.original: וְסָמַ֤ךְ יָדוֹ֙ עַל־ רֹ֣אשׁ הַשָּׂעִ֔יר וְשָׁחַ֣ט אֹת֔וֹ בִּמְק֛וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ יִשְׁחַ֥ט אֶת־ הָעֹלָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה חַטָּ֖את הֽוּא׃

passages.text: Then the priest is to take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.
passages.sermon:
The priest serves God at the altar.
The priest takes some blood from the sin offering.
He uses his finger to take the blood.
He puts the blood on the horns of the altar for burnt offerings.
He pours the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.
passages.original: וְלָקַ֨ח הַכֹּהֵ֜ן מִדַּ֤ם הַֽחַטָּאת֙ בְּאֶצְבָּע֔וֹ וְנָתַ֕ן עַל־ קַרְנֹ֖ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֑ה וְאֶת־ דָּמ֣וֹ יִשְׁפֹּ֔ךְ אֶל־ יְס֖וֹד מִזְבַּ֥ח הָעֹלָֽה׃

passages.text: He must burn all its fat on the altar, like the fat of the peace offerings; thus the priest will make atonement for that man’s sin, and he will be forgiven.
passages.sermon:
The priest must burn all the fat of the goat on the altar.
He must burn it just as he burns the fat of the peace offerings.
The priest will make atonement for the man’s sin.
God will forgive the man.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ כָּל־ חֶלְבּוֹ֙ יַקְטִ֣יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה כְּחֵ֖לֶב זֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֑ים וְכִפֶּ֨ר עָלָ֧יו הַכֹּהֵ֛ן מֵחַטָּאת֖וֹ וְנִסְלַ֥ח לֽוֹ׃פ

passages.text: And if one of the common people sins unintentionally and does what is prohibited by any of the LORD’s commandments, he incurs guilt.
passages.sermon:
A common person may sin.
He may do this by mistake.
He may do something God commanded not to do.
He breaks one of the LORD’s commandments.
He becomes guilty.
passages.original: וְאִם־ נֶ֧פֶשׁ אַחַ֛ת תֶּחֱטָ֥א בִשְׁגָגָ֖ה מֵעַ֣ם הָאָ֑רֶץ בַּ֠עֲשֹׂתָהּ אַחַ֨ת מִמִּצְוֺ֧ת יְהוָ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ תֵעָשֶׂ֖ינָה וְאָשֵֽׁם׃

passages.text: When he becomes aware of the sin he has committed, he must bring an unblemished female goat as his offering for that sin.
passages.sermon:
A common person may sin by breaking one of the LORD’s commandments.
He may not know about his sin at first.
Later, he learns about the sin he has committed.
He has done something wrong.
He must bring an offering to God.
He must bring a female goat.
The goat must have no defects.
He brings this goat for the sin he has committed.
passages.original: א֚וֹ הוֹדַ֣ע אֵלָ֔יו חַטָּאת֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֑א וְהֵבִ֨יא קָרְבָּנ֜וֹ שְׂעִירַ֤ת עִזִּים֙ תְּמִימָ֣ה נְקֵבָ֔ה עַל־ חַטָּאת֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָֽא׃

passages.text: He is to lay his hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter it at the place of the burnt offering.
passages.sermon:
A common person brings a sin offering when he sins unintentionally.
He must lay his hand on the head of the sin offering.
He must slaughter the sin offering.
He must do this at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered.
passages.original: וְסָמַךְ֙ אֶת־ יָד֔וֹ עַ֖ל רֹ֣אשׁ הַֽחַטָּ֑את וְשָׁחַט֙ אֶת־ הַ֣חַטָּ֔את בִּמְק֖וֹם הָעֹלָֽה׃

passages.text: Then the priest is to take some of its blood with his finger, put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.
passages.sermon:
The priest serves in the tabernacle.
The priest takes some of the animal’s blood.
He uses his finger to take the blood.
He puts the blood on the horns of the altar for burnt offerings.
He pours all the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.
passages.original: וְלָקַ֨ח הַכֹּהֵ֤ן מִדָּמָהּ֙ בְּאֶצְבָּע֔וֹ וְנָתַ֕ן עַל־ קַרְנֹ֖ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֑ה וְאֶת־ כָּל־ דָּמָ֣הּ יִשְׁפֹּ֔ךְ אֶל־ יְס֖וֹד הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

passages.text: Then he is to remove all the fat, just as it is removed from the peace offering, and the priest is to burn it on the altar as a pleasing aroma to the LORD. In this way the priest will make atonement for him, and he will be forgiven.
passages.sermon:
The priest serves in the tabernacle.
He must remove all the fat from the sin offering.
He removes the fat in the same way as he removes fat from the peace offering.
The priest burns the fat on the altar.
The burning fat gives a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
The priest makes atonement for the person who brought the offering.
God forgives that person.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ כָּל־ חֶלְבָּ֣הּ יָסִ֗יר כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר הוּסַ֣ר חֵלֶב֮ מֵעַ֣ל זֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִים֒ וְהִקְטִ֤יר הַכֹּהֵן֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה לְרֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָ֑ה וְכִפֶּ֥ר עָלָ֛יו הַכֹּהֵ֖ן וְנִסְלַ֥ח לֽוֹ׃פ

passages.text: If, however, he brings a lamb as a sin offering, he must bring an unblemished female.
passages.sermon: A man may bring a lamb as his sin offering.\r\nHe must bring a female lamb.\r\nThe lamb must have no blemish.
passages.original: וְאִם־ כֶּ֛בֶשׂ יָבִ֥יא קָרְבָּנ֖וֹ לְחַטָּ֑את נְקֵבָ֥ה תְמִימָ֖ה יְבִיאֶֽנָּה׃

passages.text: And he is to lay his hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter it as a sin offering at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered.
passages.sermon:
A man brings a sin offering to God.
He must lay his hand on the head of the animal for the sin offering.
He must slaughter the animal as a sin offering.
He must do this at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered.
passages.original: וְסָמַךְ֙ אֶת־ יָד֔וֹ עַ֖ל רֹ֣אשׁ הַֽחַטָּ֑את וְשָׁחַ֤ט אֹתָהּ֙ לְחַטָּ֔את בִּמְק֕וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשְׁחַ֖ט אֶת־ הָעֹלָֽה׃

passages.text: Then the priest is to take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and pour out the rest of its blood at the base of the altar.
passages.sermon:
The priest serves in the Tabernacle.
The priest takes some blood from the sin offering.
He uses his finger to take the blood.
He puts the blood on the horns of the altar for burnt offerings.
He pours all the remaining blood at the base of the altar.
passages.original: וְלָקַ֨ח הַכֹּהֵ֜ן מִדַּ֤ם הַֽחַטָּאת֙ בְּאֶצְבָּע֔וֹ וְנָתַ֕ן עַל־ קַרְנֹ֖ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֑ה וְאֶת־ כָּל־ דָּמָ֣הּ יִשְׁפֹּ֔ךְ אֶל־ יְס֖וֹד הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

passages.text: And he shall remove all the fat, just as the fat of the lamb is removed from the peace offerings, and he shall burn it on the altar along with the offerings made by fire to the LORD. In this way the priest will make atonement for him for the sin he has committed, and he will be forgiven.
passages.sermon:
The priest removes all the fat from the sin offering.
He removes the fat in the same way as he removes the fat from the lamb of the peace offerings.
The priest burns the fat on the altar.
He burns it with the offerings made by fire to the LORD.
The priest makes atonement for the person who sinned.
The person is forgiven for his sin.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ כָּל־ חֶלְבָּ֣ה יָסִ֗יר כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יוּסַ֥ר חֵֽלֶב־ הַכֶּשֶׂב֮ מִזֶּ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִים֒ וְהִקְטִ֨יר הַכֹּהֵ֤ן אֹתָם֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה עַ֖ל אִשֵּׁ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְכִפֶּ֨ר עָלָ֧יו הַכֹּהֵ֛ן עַל־ חַטָּאת֥וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ חָטָ֖א וְנִסְלַ֥ח לֽוֹ׃פ
